summary: Branches between two audio codec transforms (AudioCodecMDCTFFTTransform and MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT) on the global flag byte_5D79DC. Reads an output buffer offset from field a1+0x11C and adds 128, reads an input value from a2+80, then forwards the same argument set to whichever transform the flag selects and returns its result.

local_names.a1: receiver object; field at +0x11C read for the output buffer offset
local_names.a2: unmodeled base; field at +80 read for the input value forwarded to the transforms
local_names.v8: 136-byte stack scratch buffer passed to both transforms

operations.description: v7 = *(DWORD*)(a1 + 0x11C) + 128; reads field this+0x11C and adds 128 to form the output buffer offset used as the final argument of both transforms
v6 = *(DWORD*)(a2 + 80); reads an input value from an unmodeled second base and forwards it to the selected transform
Tests global byte_5D79DC; nonzero selects AudioCodecMDCTFFTTransform, zero selects MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT
When byte_5D79DC is nonzero: AudioCodecMDCTFFTTransform(a3, v6, v8, a4, a5, v7)
When byte_5D79DC is zero: MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT(a3, v6, v8, a4, a5, v7) with the same argument set
Returns the selected transform's result directly
